theorems.statement: ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (f : Eucl m → Eucl m') (A O : Set (Eucl m)) (Λ : ℝ≥0), IsOpen O → A ⊆ O → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → (∀ x ∈ O, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ Λ) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ A)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m')) k, ∃ η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl m)) k, (∃ N : Set (Eucl m), IsOpen N ∧ A ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x = ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) (f x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ f x)) ∧ ∀ C : ℝ, (∀ y, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl m') k) y) ≤ C) → ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl m) k) x) ≤ (Λ : ℝ) ^ k * C
